typst-render.description: The Typst PDF renderer sidecar (apps/typst-render, converse-frontends#456) that the console's report export POSTs to on 127.0.0.1:8080. Story ai-helm-values#346. Disabled by default -- the chart can land before the console route that calls it. Enabling this container REQUIRES enabling console.persistence.typst-tmp with it: the container runs with readOnlyRootFilesystem and every render needs a writable /tmp (apps/typst-render/src/render.ts mkdtemps one throwaway directory per request). Helm cannot express that cross-key dependency, so it is stated here, in values.yaml and in README.md instead.

tag.description: MUST be an explicit published tag or digest. `latest` is rejected outright rather than merely discouraged: this container is a document compiler, so an unpinned reference makes 'how does last month's report render' depend on when a pod happened to restart. That is the exact breakage class pinning exists to prevent, and a schema rejection at helm lint/install time is the only place it can be caught before a cluster picks it up.

config.yaml.description: The full apps/console config.yaml document for this deployment (server.js's config-loader.ts reads it -- see that file's header comment for the {env:VAR} placeholder syntax it supports). A real deployment supplies its own complete document here (its own Keycloak issuer, backend URLs, etc. as plain literals; secrets as {env:VAR} placeholders backed by a mounted Secret) rather than overriding individual fields.

branding-logo.description: issue #368 (Phase H, runtime white-label branding). Optional -- disabled (console.configMaps.branding-logo.enabled: false) by default, unlike console-config. Holds the operator's logo file as base64 binaryData (app-template's own values schema forbids a ConfigMap entry from carrying both data and binaryData in one resource, hence a separate configMap from branding-style below -- see values.yaml's own comment on persistence.branding-logo).

logo.png.description: Base64-encoded logo file, mounted at /tmp/branding/logo.png (console.persistence.branding-logo). Despite the literal key name, any of the extensions apps/console's env.ts accepts (.png/.svg/.jpg/.jpeg/.webp) may be supplied here -- the key is the ConfigMap's, not a format constraint; config.yaml's own branding.logo path decides the actual served Content-Type.

branding-logo-light.description: Per-theme logos addendum (owner directive 2026-08-31, "White is for dark themes"). Optional -- disabled by default, matching branding-logo above. Holds the operator's light-theme (wireframe) logo file as base64 binaryData, the light-theme counterpart to branding-logo (config.yaml's branding.logo doubles as both the default AND dark-theme mark). Only meaningful when branding-logo is ALSO enabled -- apps/console's env.ts fails config parsing on a branding.logoLight-without-branding.logo document.

logo-light.png.description: Base64-encoded light-theme logo file, mounted at /tmp/branding/logo-light.png (console.persistence.branding-logo-light). Despite the literal key name, any of the extensions apps/console's env.ts accepts (.png/.svg/.jpg/.jpeg/.webp) may be supplied here -- the key is the ConfigMap's, not a format constraint; config.yaml's own branding.logoLight path decides the actual served Content-Type.

branding-style.description: issue #368 (Phase H). Optional -- disabled by default, matching branding-logo above. Holds the operator's daisyUI custom-property override stylesheet as plain text (GET /branding/override.css filters it server-side -- see apps/console/src/server/branding-css-filter.ts).

override.style.description: CSS custom-property overrides (:root / [data-theme="..."] blocks only), mounted at /tmp/branding/override.style (console.persistence.branding-style).
